always_encrypted.description: Specifies whether TLS is required. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.

storage_account_key.description: The access key of the Azure storage account you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment.

storage_account_name.description: The name of the Azure storage account you want to use to stage your data. Use this parameter only if you are using Hybrid Deployment.

tunnel_host.description: SSH server name. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.

tunnel_port.description: SSH server port name. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user name. Must be populated if `connection_type` is set to `SshTunnel`.
